text:
Devin: heads up — customer reported repeated schema validation failures for function calls since this morning. 5 separate incidents.
Amanda: can you paste an example error/log?
Devin: from prod logs:
```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-17T09:12:03Z","level":"error","service":"inference","req_id":"req_8a3","error":"SchemaValidationError","details":"missing required field \"amount\" in args for tool 'charge_card'"}
```
Kai: hmm, sounds like the tool-chooser returned the right tool but the args were mangled. Any repro request payloads?
Devin: yes — customer request body (redacted):
```json
{"user_id":"cust_99","intent":"pay_invoice","tool_request":{"name":"charge_card","args":"{\"card_id\":\"card_123\", \"amt\": 100}"}}
```
Lee: ah — args is a stringified JSON with a wrong key name (amt) vs expected amount. That would trigger schema validation.
Amanda: do we know which model response produced this? Could be model truncation or a change in tool selection prompt.
Devin: CI golden-eval caught something similar overnight: nightly/toolcall-golden-tests failed 1/120 (tool_selection_schema.test). Link: https://ci.internal/runs/7890
support-bot: CI alert: job nightly/toolcall-golden-tests #7890 failed — regression suspected in commit c3f8b2b (PR #4123)
Kai: PR #4123 changed the function-calling prompt template and added a post-process step that attempts to coerce args. Suspect that coercion turns objects into strings in some edge cases.
oncall-jen: assigning to eng-runtime to triage. @kai @lee can you reproduce locally and add minimal repro steps? I'll notify customer with a short workaround.
Lee: repro steps I ran:
1) checkout main@c3f8b2b
2) start local runtime with TEST_TOOL_SCHEMA=1
3) send sample prompt from tests/golden/toolcall/pay_invoice.golden.json
4) observe response: tool_request.args becomes a quoted string when model uses double-nested JSON
Commands:
```
git checkout c3f8b2b
./dev/run_local.sh --env TEST_TOOL_SCHEMA=1
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat -d @tests/requests/pay_invoice_input.json
```
Kai: stacktrace from local repro:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'amount' of undefined
 at validateArgs (/app/src/tooling/schema_validator.js:128:22)
 at handleToolCall (/app/src/tooling/handler.js:85:18)
```
Devin: customer workaround suggested: send legacy wrapper flag to bypass post-process: X-Override-Tool-Coerce: true — will keep calls unmodified. But that's not a safe long-term fix.
Amanda: I ran the golden prompt eval against HEAD and diffed model outputs: the model now sometimes wraps the args block in a string when the output contains backticks or nested JSON examples. Sample diff shows the model putting `"{...}"` instead of {...}.
Kai: probable root cause: new prompt includes an example with a JSON-as-string to show edgecases; model learned to emulate that pattern. We should update the post-process to detect stringified JSON and parse it before validation.
oncall-jen: action items:
- Kai/Lee: add a unit test for stringified-args parsing and fix post-process (ETA 4 hours)
- Devin: send customer an update + temporary header workaround and ETA
- Amanda: add a flaky gating alert on nightly/toolcall-golden-tests and create a regression ticket linking PR #4123
- Support-bot: tagging case #CH-4432 as escalated
Lee: quick patch diff I tested locally:
```diff
- if (typeof args === 'string') throw new Error('args must be object');
+ if (typeof args === 'string') {
+   try { args = JSON.parse(args); } catch (e) { throw new Error('args must be object'); }
+ }
```
Kai: looks reasonable. Also add a safety cap to prevent parsing huge strings.
Devin: customer replied: "Thanks — please fix, we see 10% of calls failing during peak." they're requesting ETA asap.
oncall-jen: I'll prepare a canary rollout once patch merged. Keep updates in this thread and paste PR link.
Amanda: adding regression note to evals board: /boards/toolcall-regressions, pin failing golden prompt test and attach sample inputs.
Kai: will open PR shortly (will reference this thread and include the minimal repro, unit tests, and CI adjustments).
Devin: thanks everyone — please mark when PR merges so I can confirm with customer.
support-bot: case #CH-4432 updated: status -> investigating :mag:
Lee: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/4217 — includes the parse fallback and unit tests.
oncall-jen: merging to canary in 30m and monitor nightly/golden after.
Devin: noted. :thumbsup:
